text:
finn: heads-up: onboarding sample caused churn today. types look fine in node but collapse in the edge bundle.

clare: can you show the tiniest repro you got?

finn: tiny: we have `fetchModel<T>(opts)` declared as two overloads to support streaming vs sync. local node build keeps `T`, edge bundle (vite+rollup) yields `any`.

toni: what does package.json exports/types look like? dual exports often bite bundlers.

finn: exports map: `{ "./": { "import": "dist/esm/index.js", "require": "dist/cjs/index.cjs", "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" } }`. tsconfig for sample uses `moduleResolution: "bundler"`.

guillermo: bundler resolution + conditional exports + overloads = bad combo. if the final d.ts the bundler sees doesn't preserve a single clear signature, TS widens.

clare: specific repro at call site: `const r = await fetchModel<{name:string}>({route:'/whoami'})` -> node: `r.name` ok. edge-bundle: `r` is `any`.

toni: workaround: change helper to single generic signature with discriminant: `fetchModel<T>(opts: Req & {mode: 'sync'|'stream'}): Promise<T|Stream>`  forces narrower inference.

finn: tried that but it touches public API surface; for sample I patched the build: set `moduleResolution: "node"` and added `types` explicit path for the esm entry in package exports. that fixed the sample CI.

guillermo: note: we also had auth wrapper typed as overloads (`wrapAuth(callback)` vs `wrapAuth(promise)`) and saw contextual return types fall back to `unknown` in edge builds. users then sprinkle `as any` in onboarding.

clare: we should add a short "Edge bundlers + TS" snippet in quickstart: prefer ESM types entry, pin moduleResolution, and avoid overloads in helper wrappers.

toni: propose longer-term SDK changes: 1) consolidate typings to a single canonical shape (avoid `export =` fallback), 2) add an explicit `types/edge.d.ts` in package exports so bundlers have a stable path, 3) audit wrappers (auth/retry) to use single-generic + discriminant.

finn: opened issue #4231 with repro and a draft PR that updates sample tsconfig and CI to run the real bundler + `tsc`. also added a small lint rule for samples banning `as any` / `// @ts-ignore` unless flagged with a comment.

type-bot: CI status: node-cjs typecheck OK. edge-bundle typecheck failed on master at 2799997600; branch `devex/edge-typing-stabilize` passes.

guillermo: we should also add a tiny note in SDK changelog about callers relying on inference and breaking changes if we change overloads. keep breaking changes explicit.

clare: agreed. for immediate onboarding pain, sample fixes + CI + docs will unblock new users. long-term SDK cleanup tracked in the issue.

finn: thanks team. PR will be up this afternoon. tl;dr: generics + overloads + conditional exports + bundler dts rewriting = inference gaps in edge builds; mitigations: pin resolution, explicit esm types, avoid overloads in wrappers, and CI to catch regressions. :ship:
